    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AtomicFiles
    Writes saved documents through temporary files and destination replacement.
    BlockPlan
    Resolves the planned block state at a local coordinate without storing a volume.
    Bounds
    Describes an inclusive block volume and its indexed traversal coordinates.
    BrigadierCommands
    Builds the native command tree sent to Minecraft clients.
    CellPosition
    Identifies one cell in a maze's logical graph.
    CellSize
    Describes the dimensions of a logical maze grid.
    ChatUI
    Exposes a command-facing facade for the plugin's chat panels.
    CreateMazeRequest
    Describes a new maze and the overrides applied to its selected preset.
    CreateMazeRequest.Builder
    Assembles immutable creation requests using direct override values.
    CreateMazeRequest.Placement
    Determines which existing blocks are accepted by creation preflight.
    DefaultResources
    Installs the bundled configuration and preset files that are missing locally.
    Direction
    Defines the cardinal connections used by the logical maze graph.
    GenerationSettings
    Controls topology generation independently of Bukkit worlds and block palettes.
    GenerationSettings.Mode
    Selects the topology contract of the generated graph.
    MazeApiProvider
    Implements the Bukkit-registered public API using the plugin's internal services.
    MazeBounds
    Describes an immutable inclusive volume of world blocks.
    MazeCommands
    Receives ACF command invocations and routes them through common validation.
    MazeEngineApi
    Provides access to the public MazeEngine services.
    MazeEnginePlugin
    Coordinates the lifecycle of the MazeEngine plugin and its shared services.
    MazeGenerator
    Generates a deterministic connected cell graph using a growing-tree algorithm.
    MazeGeometry
    Describes structural maze dimensions in Minecraft blocks.
    MazeId
    Identifies a saved maze using the same naming rules as commands.
    MazeLayout
    Stores an immutable logical cell graph with entrance and exit portals.
    MazeLayout.Portal
    Identifies a boundary cell and the side opening to the outside.
    MazeLocation
    Stores a world block position without retaining a live Bukkit world.
    MazeOperation
    Tracks exactly one accepted world-editing operation.
    MazeOperationCompletedEvent
    Called after a maze operation has completed successfully.
    MazeOperationFailedEvent
    Called when an accepted maze operation ends with failure or cancellation.
    MazeOperations
    Submits maze creation, regeneration, repair, and removal requests.
    MazeOperations.RemovalMode
    Determines what happens to the maze's block volume during removal.
    MazePlaceholders
    Publishes maze metadata through the optional PlaceholderAPI expansion.
    MazeRecord
    Retains the saved state needed to manage and reconstruct one maze.
    MazeRecord.Status
    Describes the saved record's preparation, mutation, and recovery lifecycle.
    MazeRegistry
    Provides read-only access to saved maze records and their cell graphs.
    MazeRepository
    Persists one validated YAML document per saved maze.
    MazeService
    Coordinates saved maze state, authorized operations, and their execution resources.
    MazeService.MazeExistsException
    Reports a creation request conflicting with an existing saved maze name.
    MazeService.OperationOutcome
    Carries the terminal record or failure delivered to the operation observer.
    MazeService.OperationTicket
    Binds a unique accepted operation to its internal completion future.
    MazeService.UnknownMazeException
    Reports an identifier with no current saved maze record.
    MazeSnapshot
    Captures an immutable description of a saved maze at one point in time.
    MazeSnapshot.Status
    Describes the saved lifecycle of a maze record.
    MazeVisuals
    Owns private previews and route guides anchored to maze world coordinates.
    Messages
    Loads and renders the plugin's configured MiniMessage templates.
    MobSpawnListener
    Cancels mob spawn attempts within maze footprints when prevention is enabled.
    OperationKind
    Identifies the world-editing action associated with an operation.
    OperationProgress
    Captures a point-in-time progress sample for one operation handle.
    OperationProgress.State
    Describes whether an operation is active or has reached a final outcome.
    OperationResult
    Describes the successful final outcome of one world-editing operation.
    OperationSafetyListener
    Prevents player and block interactions from disrupting active maze operations.
    OptionalIntegrations
    Owns optional integrations enabled alongside the plugin's core services.
    Palette
    Stores validated block-state entries and their deterministic selection policy.
    Palette.Entry
    Pairs a portable block-state string with its selection weight.
    Palette.Pattern
    Selects how palette entries are applied to block coordinates.
    PendingActions
    Owns short-lived review tokens for destructive chat actions.
    Preset
    Describes the complete theme and generation settings retained by a maze.
    Preset.Builder
    Collects named settings before publishing an immutable, validated preset.
    Preset.Difficulty
    Labels the intended challenge of a theme for display.
    Preset.Placement
    Selects creation preflight rules for existing terrain.
    PresetRegistry
    Provides the preset metadata used when submitting new maze requests.
    PresetSnapshot
    Captures public metadata for a configured or saved maze preset.
    PresetSnapshot.Algorithm
    Describes how the generator connects the logical cell graph.
    PresetSnapshot.Difficulty
    Provides the challenge label assigned by the preset author.
    PreviewMesh
    Builds a bounded box mesh representing the complete planned maze footprint.
    PreviewMesh.Box
    Stores one local rectangular region in the preview mesh.
    PreviewMesh.Kind
    Identifies the structural role of one preview mesh box.
    ProgressSettings
    Stores the appearance and visibility settings for operation boss bars.
    RegionSelection
    Carries a resolved WorldEdit cuboid selection and its loaded Bukkit world.
    Settings
    Contains the validated configuration published for the running plugin.
    Snapshot
    Defines indexed capture, restoration, and persistence of original terrain.
    TeleportDestination
    Describes an exact arrival position and orientation in a world.
    TeleportPoint
    Stores a saved custom arrival position and facing in a specific world.
    TerrainProtectionListener
    Protects saved maze terrain from player edits and environmental changes.
    VisualSettings
    Stores validated preview, guide, and private-display configuration.
    WorldEditBridge
    Adapts optional WorldEdit functionality to maze selections and terrain snapshots.
    WorldGuardBridge
    Checks optional WorldGuard build permissions before maze terrain is edited.
